author: nhab
quote: This game has great visuals, pretty good attention to detail, but an abysmal storyline. It includes too much realism in game, having to refuel, can’t carry larger weapons in your weapon wheel all at once. Driving is wonky, cars get damaged way too easily, shooting is absolutely awful. It has plenty of annoying characters that make you frequently wonder why they were included in the story. The honor system is dumb, this is GTA not red dead, and you can’t STEAL CARS. You can’t steal certain cars without key cloners, certain cars have trackers and advanced security. It’s a video game, it doesn’t need to be hyper realistic. It should be a fun game to play and not a puzzle on how to play it. They’ve strayed away from how their older titles used to be with great stories and not insane realism, and in my opinion, released something that isn’t in the top 10 games they’ve ever made. A little bit of realism is good but it doesn’t have to be just like real life. I want to get on this game and steal whatever cars I want and not be limited to my criminal options. I also hate the fact that this is digital only and no physical media. Jason is treated like a little puppy dog with Lucia and is stripped of his manhood. What were they thinking when they made this game? Did they really think this would appeal to their main audience? Honestly, asides from a couple things this game is really hot garbage. If their next releases are anything like this one, I’ll definitely pass on getting them. Rockstars glory days are way over. When Dan Houser, Leslie Benzies, Lazlow Jones, and Michael Unsworth left Rockstar the company has gone tumbling downhill and released increasingly disappointing updates and video games. I feel like this game could have been way more of a success if they hadn’t given it such a crappy story. You run around doing errands 90% of the time, and the game has lots of bugs. They had 13 years to come up with something new and this is what they gave us? Calling this game a disappointment is an understatement.

author: nhab
quote: Where to start? The game has over 400 cars but hardly any of them are available at one time. You have to wait for the used car dealership to cycle through the cars. You can’t play the campaign without a internet connection and the latest updates have completely nerfed the payouts. They could have made a great game but instead decided to create an abomination that is very annoying to play. Completely the menu’s and the campaign hardly took any time at all which made me wonder if it was worth paying $70 to play a game for a max of 3 days. If you want certain cars you either have to wait for them to be put in the game via used car or legend dealership or if you don’t have the credits, pony up a lot of your real money to pay for it. Don’t make my mistake and buy the game. Save your money for something else.
